instruction: Transform the graphic found at '/home/user/logo.png' into Adobe Illustrator format to support my design workflow.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because GIMP is a raster graphics editor and cannot export to AI (Adobe Illustrator) format, which is a proprietary vector graphics format. GIMP does not have the capability to convert raster images to vector formats like AI.
